# S5-nano

Maritaca AI · released 2026-11

Maritaca AI's Portuguese/English model built on Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B by continued pretraining plus post-training; Think (default) and Instruct modes; text+image (vision encoder) with an MTP layer. BF16 weights committed 2026-11-02 (commit fe2c063); later commits to the pinned sha fe3a358 (2026-11-10) are card edits. LICENSE is Apache 2.0 with 'Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud' (inherited Qwen notice). Hosted on Maritaca's own API as S5-nano (256K context there). Results use the Think table (highest reasoning setting); Instruct-mode values not imported. Card scores are Maritaca's own runs of all listed models; other models' columns not used. API price: Maritaca's own model docs (observed 2026-11-12): 'R$ 0.10 per 1M input tokens and R$ 0.60 per 1M output tokens'; accepted API names S5-nano / s5-nano. Prices are in BRL, so no USD price\_in/price\_out recorded (no conversion); a first-party-maritaca ledger entry would be needed before recording any price.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano/blob/fe3a3581c33cb22917770ef1987b7c6e30929425/README.md)

## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Maritaca AI) · price unknown · [docs.maritaca.ai](https://docs.maritaca.ai/en/models)

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano/blob/fe3a3581c33cb22917770ef1987b7c6e30929425/README.md): Pinned card: 'The context window supports up to 262,144 tokens'; observed 2026-11-12. Maritaca's API docs list 256K max context and 32K max output for the hosted S5 Nano.</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run S5-nano (Q4_K_M, needs 5.1 GB memory, 3.46 GB download, from [huggingface.co/maritaca-ai](https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF/blob/892d3b6ce018802d74fed1650e712e5fcd5a42b5/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (7 GB memory, 5.28 GB download) `llama cli -hf maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run S5-nano (Q4_K_M, needs 5.1 GB memory, 3.46 GB download, from [huggingface.co/maritaca-ai](https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF/blob/892d3b6ce018802d74fed1650e712e5fcd5a42b5/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (7 GB memory, 5.28 GB download) `lms get https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF@Q8_0 -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run S5-nano (Q4_K_M, needs 5.1 GB memory, 3.46 GB download, from [huggingface.co/maritaca-ai](https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF/blob/892d3b6ce018802d74fed1650e712e5fcd5a42b5/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run hf.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (7 GB memory, 5.28 GB download) `ollama run hf.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano-GGUF:Q8_0`

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs 11.3 GB memory, 9.32 GB download, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/maritaca-ai](https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano/blob/fe3a3581c33cb22917770ef1987b7c6e30929425/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   vllm serve maritaca-ai/S5-nano --max-model-len 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder
   ```

Other versions: fp8 (7.5 GB memory, 5.76 GB download, NVIDIA only) `vllm serve maritaca-ai/S5-nano-FP8 --max-model-len 262144 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder`

Model repository and documentation: [huggingface.co/maritaca-ai](https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/S5-nano)
